definition: The task of automatically generating a natural language description of the contents of an image.
details: Image captioning combines visual understanding with language generation, and is a classic benchmark task for evaluating multimodal models that must connect visual and textual representations.

explainer.lead: Image captioning automatically generates a natural language description of an image's contents. It matters as a classic benchmark for multimodal models that must connect visual and textual representations.

tiers.eli5: The computer looks at a picture and writes a sentence saying what is in it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers combine visual understanding with language generation; judging quality is the pitfall, since a caption can be fluent yet miss the image's contents.
tiers.paperLevel: The task of automatically generating a natural language description of an image's contents; it serves as a benchmark task for evaluating multimodal models.

explainer.example: Given a photograph, the model outputs a sentence describing its contents as a natural language caption.
